item.title: [infoq] 代理技能 Ponytail 在贡献者提出质疑后修正了自身的基准测试结果
item.description: Ponytail, an open-source skill that cuts over-engineering by injecting decision rules into coding agents, has amassed over 82,000 GitHub stars since June 12. Its original benchmark claimed 80–94% code reduction, but Colin Eberhardt of Scott Logic showed the project was a ~100-line Markdown restatement of YAGNI—a single 'write one line' prompt even beat it. The author then reran tests on a real FastAPI/React repo, revising the average reduction to ~54%, with costs down ~20% and execution 27% fast

item.title: [infoq] HashiCorp 发布 Vault Kubernetes 密钥管理功能的公开测试版
item.description: On July 10, HashiCorp launched a public beta of Vault Kubernetes key management, adding a KMS v2–compatible plugin (vault-kube-kms) that lets clusters use Vault Enterprise as the KMS for encrypting etcd data. The design keeps key encryption keys (KEKs) in Vault, enabling centralized rotation, RBAC, and auditing without changing application code. It targets enterprise Kubernetes platforms like Red Hat OpenShift, regulated environments, and zero-trust architectures.

item.title: [infoq] eslint-rspack-plugin 5.0.0 以纯 ESM 包的形式发布，与 Rstack 生态系统保持一致
item.description: eslint-rspack-plugin 5.0.0 is now a pure ESM package, dropping CommonJS to align with Rspack 2.0 and the Rstack ecosystem. Since Node.js 20+ supports require(esm), most projects won't need changes. The plugin still runs ESLint during builds, but in watch mode only lints modified files; new options include caching, configType for flat config, threads, and lintAllFiles. The README advises running ESLint separately to keep builds fast, and Rstack's new Rslint claims 20-40x faster linting.
